verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a built-in AI assistant, Aura AI, that answers plain-language questions about your data, plus in-product AI features that draft email copy, adjust tone, and summarize live chats. These are question-answering and content-assist features; the evidence does not show the assistant executing multi-step tasks on the user's behalf. The MCP and ChatGPT/Claude integrations involve external assistants, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that the built-in assistant can take actions or complete delegated tasks (e.g., building campaigns, segments, or workflows), depth of documentation on the assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask plain‑language questions and get instant answers from your data with Aura AI.
Draft subject lines and email copy, adjust tone, and more.
Summarize live chats in one click, tailor replies to your tone, and turn quick notes into polished messages
